verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop processor (APU) with an accompanying inference SDK. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a workflow-platform capability, so this story does not apply to a chip. Nothing in the pack shows the product or its software (Ryzen AI Software, Lemonade, GAIA) shipping automation versioning or rollback, so the exception that would make the axis apply is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
